svg.title: When memory arrived
svg.desc: A timeline from 2024 to 2026 with one lane per product. ChatGPT: saved memories in April 2024, references to past chats in April 2025, dreaming in June 2026. Codex: a memory pipeline in its code from February 2026, version 2 in September 2026. Claude app: search over past chats in August 2025, a memory summary in September 2025, free users in March 2026, topics written as you chat in July 2026. Claude Code: auto memory in February 2026. Claude API: the memory tool in September 2025. Gemini app: recalls past chats in February 2025, on by default in August 2025, Personal Intelligence in January 2026, renamed memory with an import in March 2026. Gemini CLI: a save_memory tool in June 2025, plain files in four tiers and Auto Memory in April 2026. Grok: April 2025. Le Chat: September 2025. Perplexity: November 2025.
svg.text: Memory in the chat apps and the coding agents, by the month it shipped. The letter says where the date comes from.
Dates and sources: part 9 of the series, as of November 2026
